subject: FinLytics integration discovery - 5xx on inference requests
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finlytics.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinLytics integration discovery - 5xx on inference requests

Thanks again for the call this morning, Alex — great overview of the FinLytics ingestion pipeline and how you're planning to use embeddings + reranker + a structured tool-calling layer for enrichment. As promised, a quick recap and next steps so we can reproduce the 5xx you saw in demo.

Recap / priorities from our side:
- Repro: you mentioned intermittent 500/502 responses when sending combined generate + reranker requests (esp. when request payload contained long metadata arrays).
- SDK and auth: you're on redwood-js v0.9.2 and currently using API key auth via an env var.
- Routing: requests are hitting the hosted endpoint in us-west1.
- Tuning: possible timeouts and batch sizing issues for long structured output + tool calls.

Immediate asks (so we can triage quickly):
1) Please send a minimal repro request (curl or Postman) that reliably triggers a 5xx — include request headers, payload, and the timestamp of the failed request.
2) If possible, attach the server-side logs from your side (request ids, timestamps, any stack traces).
3) Confirm whether the failures happen only when reranker is enabled, or also on plain generation/embedding calls.
4) I'll loop in Camila and Neha from infra/ML infra to help reproduce and suggest a temporary workaround.

I've attached the post-call notes and will follow up with an internal ticket once we have repro steps. Proposed immediate mitigation: if you need production stability, reduce concurrent batch size and cap max_tokens while we investigate.

Thanks — available for a quick repro session later this afternoon if you want to test changes live.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: post-call-notes-20260325.pdf

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: FinLytics Support <support@finlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 13:48:22 -0700
Subject: Re: FinLytics integration discovery - 5xx on inference requests

Thanks, Marissa — appreciate the quick recap. Attaching the Postman collection and the logs you asked for. The failures look reproducible on our side; we included the exact curl we used below.

What we ran (minimal repro):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_API_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '
  {
    "model": "redwood-1.3-large",
    "input": {
      "prompt": "Extract entities and call enrichment_tool",
      "metadata": [ /* ~220 items of small json objects */ ],
      "tool_calls": [{ "tool": "enrichment_tool", "args": {"company_ids": [/* ~40 ids */] } } ]
    },
    "reranker": { "enabled": true, "top_k": 5 },
    "max_tokens": 1200
  }'

Observed behavior:
- ~80% of requests return HTTP 500 with the body: "Internal Server Error" and no request-id in response.
- When we include "reranker.enabled = false" the success rate jumps to ~98%.
- Failures occur across multiple regions but are highest when hitting us-west1.

Attached: finlytics-repro-postman.json (Postman collection with environment vars) and finlytics-5xx-logs.txt (our service logs with timestamps and the response bodies).

We're on redwood-js v0.9.2 as well; we can switch to the HTTP curl repro above or run whatever you need to reproduce.

—
Alex Rivera
Integration Lead, FinLytics
alex.rivera@finlytics.com

Attachments: finlytics-repro-postman.json, finlytics-5xx-logs.txt

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 10:05:10 -0700
Subject: Re: FinLytics integration discovery - 5xx on inference requests

Looping Dev in to triage (thanks for the clear repro, Alex). Quick notes from infra side after a first pass:

- Initial hypothesis: 5xx is triggered in the request routing/serialization layer when structured tool-calls + large metadata arrays + reranker are combined. We suspect an unhandled exception in the model-variant path that handles rerankers for redwood-1.3-large.
- Evidence: camila checked service traces for the timeframe Alex sent — we see elevated worker OOMs and one stack trace pointing at "reranker_post_process" in the response pipeline.
- Repro plan for dev: run the attached Postman collection against a staging cluster with debug logging enabled, and reproduce with a smaller metadata array to find the threshold.

Suggested temporary mitigations to reduce customer impact while we debug:
1) Increase request timeout on the routing layer from 30s -> 45s for affected routes (us-west1) — this prevents some timeouts that show up as 502/504, though won't mask crash 500s.
2) Advise FinLytics to set reranker.enabled = false OR reduce top_k to 3 until we patch the post-processing bug.
3) Add a guard in the serializer to chunk metadata arrays into smaller sub-requests when detected (medium-term).

Dev action items (Dev Patel):
- Create a minimal unit test reproducing the exception using the sample payload.
- Capture heap profiles when running the repro to confirm OOM cause.
- Open Jira INF-452 and link traces + repro collection.

I'll create INF-452 and assign to infra/backend; Marissa, I recommend we share that ticket with FinLytics to keep them updated. Alex — can you confirm whether you can toggle reranker off easily for the next 24–48 hours? If yes, we can proceed with the temporary mitigation and run staged repros.

—
Camila Reyes
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

Subject: Re: FinLytics integration discovery - 5xx on inference requests

Hi Alex — quick status update and a requested test to confirm the workaround. Thanks again for the fast repro artifacts.

What we did:
- Created Jira INF-452 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-452) and linked the Postman collection and logs.
- Dev executed the repro against a staging cluster with debug symbols and confirmed a null-pointer in the reranker post-processing when metadata array length > 150 and top_k >= 5. Heap snapshots show increased memory pressure in that code path.
- Pushed a short-term mitigation to routing: increased request timeout to 45s for requests to redwood-1.3-large in us-west1 and added a logging hook that will surface request-id in responses on failure.

What we need from you to confirm:
1) Could you run the attached updated Postman collection (finlytics-updated-postman.json) that sets reranker.top_k = 3 and max_tokens = 800? We also added an environment variable "RW_TIMEOUT=45" to simulate the increased timeout from your side.
2) If that stops the 500s, please confirm and we'll prioritize a code fix in the reranker pipeline (target: next patch release).

Temporary guidance for FinLytics (if you want highest stability):
- Disable reranker OR set top_k <= 3 for now.
- Use smaller metadata batches (split 200 items into chunks of ~60–80).
- Track request ids from responses; we've enabled them for failed responses in staging to aid debugging.

I'll keep this thread updated as we ship the patch. Marissa — I'll send you an internal summary for the account and link INF-452 so you can share with the customer.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
